facts.name_en: Election of the President of the Republic of Poland
facts.early_reason: a Sejm resolution of 21 September 1990 shortened President Jaruzelski's term

rules.formula: absolute majority of valid votes; otherwise a second round between the two leading candidates

facts.note: the first round of 1990 and 1995 includes votes abroad and on ships; the second round does not

sources.label: Oath dates: Polish Wikipedia, Prezydent Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej

outcome.note: the Sejm resolved on 21 September 1990 to shorten Jaruzelski's term (M.P. 1990 poz. 289); the constitutional amendment of 27 September 1990 (Dz.U. 1990 poz. 397) did so
